[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 425
- Contributor(s): LVSS Negócios Internacionais Ltda (Flow Vista)
- Description: Vendor time — LVSS / Flow Vista: 7 h 05 min (425 min) on notarization and sworn translation for the Brazilian entity set-up.
  
  **What was produced**
  
  A **Procuração Pública Bastante** (public power of attorney), executed 13 October 2026 at the **8º Tabelião de Notas de São Paulo** (Rua das Palmeiras 353, Santa Cecília), recorded at Livro 4100, págs. 395/398, Primeiro Traslado.
  
  - **Outorgante:** Zhiwen Teh (Gary Teh) — Singaporean, passport holder, CPF on file
  - **Procuradora:** Paloma Pinheiro Lecheta — Florianópolis/SC, Rua dos Merlins 156, Jurerê Internacional (the DAO's principal-office address on the Próspera LLC record)
  - **Powers granted (a–q):** represent as administrator/director of any Brazilian company; incorporate companies of any type and obtain CNPJ; acquire/transfer quotas; vote at assemblies; represent before Receita Federal and Banco Central incl. RDE-IED foreign-investment registration; full banking mandate; represent before the judiciary; receive service of process (valid 3 years past end of management, per IN DREI 81/2020)
  - **Sworn translation:** Maria Rita Guedes Queiroz Lopes — tradutora pública juramentada, JUCESP matrícula 1.358 (20 Jul 2000); interpreter present at the act
  - **Notary costs:** R$ 328,18 total (emolumentos R$ 195,43; Estado R$ 55,54; Sefaz R$ 38,01; Reg. Civil R$ 10,29; TJSP R$ 13,41; Santa Casa R$ 1,95; ISS R$ 4,17; MP R$ 9,38). Recibo 27.505
  - **Digital seal:** 1145121PR000000004715626V — verifiable at selodigital.tjsp.jus.br
  - **Docuthèque validation code:** UE6ZM-73YHZ-DNBAE-PJBWE (docautentico.com.br)
  - **CNIB check:** negative (no unavailability-of-assets hit), per Provimento CNJ 39/2014
  - **PEP declaration:** outorgante declared NOT a politically exposed person, per Provimento CNJ 88/2019
  
  **Why it matters**
  
  This is the instrument that lets the DAO actually *use* the Brazilian entity: it authorises incorporation, CNPJ issuance, and — critically — **RDE-IED registration of foreign capital** with the Central Bank. Without RDE-IED, foreign investment into the Brazilian entity cannot be registered, which blocks the LVSS-scoped FDI structuring (clause 1.1(ii) of the 2026-10-21 service agreement).
  
  **Evidence**
  
  - Deed archived (public, PII redacted): https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/notarizations/blob/main/20261013_procuracao_publica_zhiwen_teh_REDACTED.pdf
  - Full-fidelity original (private): https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/notarizations-raw/blob/main/originals/20261013_procuracao_publica_zhiwen_teh.pdf
  - Commit (public redacted): https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/notarizations/commit/b6b45489499f4a39b39b207808cd6eeb97cbb67a
  - Commit (private original): https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/notarizations-raw/commit/29f799db0a9b54dd26afc6cd3dfec8aca0e8b570
  
  **⚠️ Two caveats on the 425 minutes**
  
  1. **The figure is the vendor's own running tally, not DAO-verified.** It comes from a WhatsApp screenshot reading "Up to now, 7h and 5 minutes" (Wed 14 Oct), reported by Vinicius Bitencourt. No timesheet was submitted.
  2. **Possible double-count against the service agreement.** The 2026-10-21 LVSS agreement fixes consideration at **USD 3,500 — of which USD 2,500 is payable in TDG** — for the Brazilian entity and FDI set-up. If notarization and translation sit inside that scope (they appear to), then crediting this separately awards TDG twice for the same work. Governor should confirm whether this row is a **record-only** entry before the TDG award is treated as live. A corrective row can zero or offset it.
  
  Contributor set to the **corporate entity**, not Vinicius Bitencourt personally — he already exists in the contributors registry as @vinibitencourt.
--------
